lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you for calling Himal Bank. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: What's your fixed deposit rate for one year?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: For one year, the rate this month is seven and a half percent, for deposits of ten thousand rupees or more. You can open one in mobile banking or at any branch.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'd like to talk to someone about a larger amount.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure. I'm connecting you to our deposits team now. I've passed on that you're asking about a one year deposit, so you won't need to repeat yourself.
